answer: A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, since the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The zephyr multiplier is published, charged in nadir, and terrace lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 9 for each identity already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. A farm of 3764 identities would post 4056 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
